description: RAG-optimized chat interface with inline source citations, source panel, and knowledge base management.

architectureNotes: RagMessage extends ChatMessage with a collapsible sources section showing citations per response.
SourcePanel is a right sidebar that displays full source content with highlighted retrieved passages.
KnowledgeBaseManager handles document upload, URL ingestion, indexing status, and source management.
Wire /api/knowledge-base/upload to parse documents, chunk them, generate embeddings, and store in your vector DB.
Chat responses should include a sources array with document title, chunk text, relevance score, and page reference.
